address: 2F, 75 Ho Tung Mau Street, Ben Nghe Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: With bare brick walls, a wood-clad high ceiling and black metal accents, the interior is the epitome of faux-industrial. Drenched in sunlight during the day, it is moodily lit at night. Either way, it has a real buzz that makes for a fun visit. Octo, which bills itself as a tapas restobar, is ideal for Spanish tapas, like their famous traditional croquettes, gazpacho and 48-month Iberico ham, washed down with a round of drinks....
